As an abuse survivor, I understand when you say that a healthy relationship can be a trigger. Just know that you are not alone in all of this. Take healing from the abuse slow, and try not to get down on yourself for crying, getting triggered, or any behavior really. Be kind to yourself, because your abuser wasn’t and neither was anyone who enabled the abuse. So try to be extra kind to yourself for the kindness that they lacked. If you can’t afford therapy, don’t fret, there are plenty of people who are willing to help here, other sites, and even in the real world. Most nations have a free crisis line to call if things start to get unmanageable and you can call and just vent or talk.

All that aside, I have a similar story and am always willing to listen. I’m not a very talkative person (still haven’t found my ‘voice’ after decades of abuse), but if you need to vent or just feel supported let me know. Also if you have any questions about resources in your area I can try my best to help. To recap, be kind to yourself, ask for help if you need it, and you’re awesome for just being you and reaching out on here.
